observations: Photo 0 and 1 show a white PlayStation-branded game console standing on a stool, shot from the side/rear angle.
A PlayStation logo and disc-slot-like edge are visible on the front panel in photo 1.
Rear/side ports (USB, power socket) are visible but no power cable is plugged in or shown separately.
Two controllers are shown: one white (DualSense-style) and one red, both resting beside the console.
No power-on screen, no home menu, no game library, and no serial/model sticker is visible in either photo.
Background shows a shop banner reading 'Pages Phones & Gadget', suggesting a retail/resale stall setting.
No box, cables, or accessories other than the two pads are shown.

identity.model: PlayStation 5 (disc edition, based on visible disc slot)
read_from: photo 1 PlayStation logo and disc slot edge

claims.evidence: No power-on, boot screen, or gameplay clip in either photo; console is static and unplugged.
No screenshot of game library or home menu shown.
Two controllers (one red, one white) are visible in both photo 0 and photo 1.
Subjective marketing claim, not a checkable fact.

risks.proof: A clip showing the console powering on to the home screen, or at least the white light sequence

risks.risk: Disc drive could be faulty or absent (if this is a digital edition mislabeled)
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the disc slot area confirming a physical slot
risks.if_unproven: priced as disc edition unverified, treat as base/digital-equivalent value

risks.risk: Claimed installed games may not exist or may be pirated/unlicensed copies
risks.proof: Screenshot of the game library on the home screen

risks.risk: One or both controllers may not pair or may have drift/battery issues
risks.proof: Short clip showing both pads connected and responsive in the menu
risks.if_unproven: priced as one or both pads non-functional

risks.risk: No power cable, HDMI cable, or original box shown, which affects completeness
risks.proof: Photo of included accessories laid out together

risks.risk: Unknown usage history or refurbishment status (could be a used/refurbished unit sold as new)
risks.proof: Photo of serial number sticker or purchase receipt

proof_requests: Video of the console powering on and reaching the home screen
Screenshot of the installed games library
Close-up photo of the disc slot and serial number sticker
Short clip showing both controllers connected and functioning (buttons, sticks)
Photo of all included accessories (cables, box, charging dock)
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable as a Sony PlayStation 5 console with two controllers, but none of the seller's functional claims (working console, installed games) are verifiable from the photos, so it must be priced at worst case as a non-verified/possibly non-functional unit with two pads included.
